# pantechdynamics_snapshot (Resource)

A point-in-time snapshot of an instance's root disk or of a volume. Set exactly one of instance_id and volume_id. A snapshot cannot be changed: any change replaces it. Snapshot storage is billed monthly by size. On the staging platform, snapshots of a stopped instance and of a local volume attached to an instance succeeded, while snapshots of a running instance and of a detached shared volume failed.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# A snapshot is a point-in-time copy of a volume or of an instance's root disk, and
# its storage is billed monthly by size. On staging, these worked:
#   - a local volume attached to an instance
#   - the root disk of a stopped instance
# and these failed: a running instance's root disk, and a detached shared volume.

# A snapshot of a volume that is attached to an instance.
resource "pantechdynamics_snapshot" "data_before_upgrade" {
  name      = "before-upgrade"
  volume_id = pantechdynamics_volume.data.id
}

# A snapshot of an instance's root disk. Stop the instance first.
resource "pantechdynamics_snapshot" "web_root" {
  name        = "web-root-1"
  instance_id = pantechdynamics_instance.web.id

  timeouts = {
    create = "30m"
    delete = "20m"
  }
}

# A snapshot cannot be changed: any change replaces it. To get a volume back from
# one, set source_snapshot_id on a pantechdynamics_volume (untested on staging).
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the snapshot, unique for its instance or volume. A snapshot that failed still holds its name. Changing it replaces the snapshot.

### Optional

- `instance_id` (String) Id of the instance whose root disk is copied, from pantechdynamics_instance. Stop the instance first: a snapshot of a running instance failed on staging. Set this or volume_id. Changing it replaces the snapshot.
- `timeouts` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--timeouts))
- `volume_id` (String) Id of the volume to copy, from pantechdynamics_volume. Set this or instance_id. Changing it replaces the snapshot.

### Read-Only

- `completed_at` (String) When the snapshot completed, in RFC 3339 UTC, to the second.
- `created_at` (String) When the snapshot was requested, in RFC 3339 UTC, to the second.
- `id` (String) Identifier of the snapshot, starting with snap_.
- `observed_state` (String) State of the snapshot as the platform sees it, for example "active".
- `size_bytes` (Number) Size of the snapshot in bytes. Zero until it completes.
- `trigger` (String) "manual" for a snapshot made here, or "automatic" for one made by a schedule.

<a id="nestedatt--timeouts"></a>
### Nested Schema for `timeouts`

Optional:

- `create` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours).
- `delete` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours). Setting a timeout for a Delete operation is only applicable if changes are saved into state before the destroy operation occurs.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Snapshots are imported by id. The source (instance or volume) is read from the API.
terraform import pantechdynamics_snapshot.data_before_upgrade snap_06gge7z00ntc958r3qa4dm3364
```
